notes: Motion pass. Switching tabs used to be a cut: the bars stay put, so the page between them now fades out and the next one fades in, and a screen coming out of its load gate fades in instead of snapping on. Quiz and exam questions, cloze sentences and recall prompts fade in where the last one stood, answer verdicts open under the question rather than shoving the button down the screen, progress bars walk instead of jumping, and the journey's stones fade when you tap another level. Everything collapses to instant if you have animations turned off system-wide.
